title: Capstone: Frappe Bench par Apna Personal AI-SDLC Engineering System Banao
summary: Modules 00 se 10 ko ek aise system mein jodo jise tum Frappe bench par chala sako aur jis par bharosa kar sako: AI-SDLC-frappe/ ke har folder ko uske purpose, module aur format tag se map karo; wiring prove karo, bench-facing pieces samet (spice_lite layout, patches.txt modules, DocType folders, bench list-apps), ek zero-dependency check se jo sre ke Bash guard aur uski preloaded skill ke beech ek real seam bhi dhoondhta hai; ek feature (OBS-51, fixture aur patch ke saath ek naya DocType) aur ek country-site incident (100-subject lastn ward board jo gunicorn ko saturate karta hai) ko orchestrator, har agent aur har human gate se trace karo; aur end mein system ko ek measured checklist ke saath apne spice_next_core-style bench par le jao.
prerequisites: `AI-SDLC-frappe/sample-app/scripts/setup-bench.sh` se bana bench (Frappe v15, PostgreSQL 16, site `test.localhost`)
Node 22, Python 3.11, agent runs ke liye authenticated Claude Code CLI

concepts.heading: Ek system, saat layers, ek external bench
concepts.body_md:
Har pichhle module ne ek layer banaya. Capstone unke beech ke seams ke baare mein hai, kyonki wahi jagah hai jahan kaam karne wale parts ka set ek kaam karne wala system nahi rehta.

| Layer | Files | Kis sawaal ka jawab deta hai |
|---|---|---|
| Knowledge | `CLAUDE.md`, `.claude/rules/`, `context/**` | Har agent bina pooche kya jaanta hai, bench kahan hai samet? |
| Capability | `.claude/skills/**`, `.mcp.json`, `mcp/` | Kaunse procedures aur tools exist karte hain? |
| Actors | `.claude/agents/*.md`, `agents/*/CONTRACT.md`, `agents/tool-guard.mjs` | Kaun kaunsa bench command chala sakta hai aur kaunsa path edit kar sakta hai? |
| Sequencing | `orchestrator.md`, entry-point skills, `workflows/*.md` | Kis order mein, kin conditions aur retries ke saath? |
| Enforcement | `.claude/settings.json`, `.claude/hooks/`, `workflows/gates.settings.json` | Har call par kya block, ask ya check hota hai? |
| Measurement | `evaluations/`, `skills/*/tests/` | Kya change ne agent ya skill ko behtar ya badtar banaya? |
| Governance | `docs/governance/`, `scripts/governance/`, `company-ai/` | Upar ki sab cheezon mein, aur DocType JSON, `patches.txt` aur `hooks.py` mein changes kaun approve karta hai? |

Frappe system ki ek aur dependency hai jo Java edition mein nahi hai: **bench repository ke bahar rehta hai**. `/home/user/frappe-bench` par `apps/spice_lite` `sample-app/spice_lite` ka symlink hai, site `test.localhost` par app installed honi chahiye, aur agent jo bhi test chalata hai woh `bench --site test.localhost run-tests` se jaata hai. Agar symlink kisi aur copy ki taraf point kare, toh agents ek tree edit karte hain aur doosra test karte hain.

Layers ek doosre ko **naam aur path** se reference karti hain, aur Claude Code mein kuch bhi tumhare liye in references ko check nahi karta. Ek `skills:` entry jo missing skill ka naam le, ek Claude Code hook command jo moved script ki taraf point kare, ek workflow step jo aise agent ka naam le jise orchestrator spawn nahi kar sakta, ya ek `patches.txt` line jiska module kabhi likha hi nahi gaya, yeh sab chup-chaap ya sabse bure waqt par fail hote hain: unknown frontmatter fields ignore hote hain, missing hook script ek non-blocking error hai, aur missing patch module sirf country site par `bench migrate` ke waqt fail hota hai. Toh practically system ko apne seams ka apna check chahiye, jo CI mein aur har workflow run se pehle chale: `scripts/capstone/verify-system.mjs` (exercise `11-verify-system`).

concepts.heading: Orchestrator aur uske human gates, reconciled
concepts.body_md:
Module 08 ne orchestrator aur uska contract banaya (dekho `08-workflow-orchestration` aur `agents/orchestrator/CONTRACT.md`; yeh module koi naya contract nahi jodta). Woh **main thread** ki tarah chalta hai: `claude --agent orchestrator --settings workflows/gates.settings.json --permission-mode default`. Docs ke do facts design ko uthate hain: uske `tools` mein `Agent(architect, developer, reviewer, tester, security, sre)` list sirf isliye enforce hoti hai kyonki woh main-thread agent hai, aur roster agents `Agent` omit karte hain (aur use `disallowedTools` mein list karte hain) taaki tree ek level deep rahe. Orchestrator ke paas na Bash hai na Edit, isliye woh kabhi `bench` nahi chala sakta.

Module 08 workflow gates ko G1, G1b, G2, G3 aur G-M number karta hai; module 10 governance layers ko G1 se G10 number karta hai. Yeh wahi controls hain, do taraf se dekhe hue:

- **G1 plan approval** = `Agent(developer)` par `ask` rule. Har developer launch, har rework samet, ek permission prompt hai.
- **G1b test-site schema** = developer ke tool-guard mein `?bench --site test.localhost migrate` (yeh `permissionDecision: "ask"` return karta hai), plus `ask` rules aur `guard-bench.mjs` (governance G2). Tum exactly dekhte ho ki kaunsi site migrate ho rahi hai.
- **G2 findings** = orchestrator ka `status: needs-human` ke saath rukna. Yeh ek **prompt instruction hai, built-in feature nahi**. Iska mechanical backstop agla `Agent(developer)` prompt aur PR hai.
- **G-M mitigation** = insaan ke alawa koi country site nahi badalta: orchestrator ke paas Bash nahi, sre ka guard sirf `test.localhost` par read-only diagnostics allow karta hai, aur `supervisorctl`, `redis-cli`, `purge-jobs`, `execute` aur `console` har agent ki pahunch se bahar hain.
- **G3 merge** = branch protection ke under PR review, `**/doctype/**`, `patches.txt`, `hooks.py`, `fixtures/**` par CODEOWNERS, aur `ai-change-gate` check apni `ai-config` (G7) aur `schema` (G8) categories ke saath.

Gated workflows `default` mode mein chalao. `dontAsk` mein har `ask` denial ban jaata hai, isliye headless run design se G1 par ruk jaata hai. Kaunsa gate mechanism hai aur kaunsa convention, yeh apne system ke baare mein bol paana sabse zaroori cheez hai.

concepts.heading: Ek feature trace karna: OBS-51 har layer se
concepts.body_md:
Committed run `workflows/examples/feature-observation-code-vocabulary/` (module 08) mein handoffs, teen real patches aur bench output hain. Capstone view (`docs/capstone/walkthrough-feature.md`) jodta hai ki har pal kya act karta hai:

1. **Pehle**: clean app tree, `verify-system.mjs --bench` WIRED, is run ke do evaluated agents (02 par architect, 08 par reviewer) ke liye eval replay green.
2. **`/feature OBS-51 ...`**: skill `disable-model-invocation: true` hai, `SubagentStop` handoff hook register karti hai, `git status --short -- sample-app` inject karti hai.
3. **01 se 03**: requirements; architect core vocabulary plus shipped fixtures decide karta hai, country apps fixture se codes jodti hain (ARC-1: fixtures har migrate par force-import hote hain); har Frappe surface ke liye ek row wala plan.
4. **G1**: `subagent_type: developer` ke saath `Agent` ke liye permission prompt.
5. **04**: developer ka guard `bench --site test.localhost run-tests` allow karta hai aur `migrate` ke liye ask karta hai (**G1b**); `Ran 53 tests ... OK` quote hota hai kyonki `bench run-tests` failures par exit 0 karta hai.
6. **scope**: `SubagentStop` hook real diff par `security-scope.mjs` chalata hai aur `SECURITY STEP: MANDATORY (rules 1, 3, 4, 5)` likhta hai.
7. **05 + 06 parallel mein**: TST-1 (non-idempotent patch), TST-2 aur SEC-1 (ek Clinician DocPerm row, do taraf se dekhi hui).
8. **G2**, phir **07** rework (G1 aur G1b phir se), `Ran 56 tests ... OK`; **08** reviewer low findings ke saath APPROVE; **09** report.
9. **G3**: PR DocType JSON, `hooks.py`, `patches.txt` aur ek fixture touch karta hai, isliye `check-ai-change-approval.mjs` tab tak fail hota hai jab tak schema owner head commit approve na kare (governance G8), aur merge ke baad har country site apni window mein migrate hoti hai (G9).

Evals aur governance alag tarah apply hote hain: governance **har run ki har tool call** par act karta hai; evaluation **system mein changes** par act karta hai (naye reviewer prompt ko PR merge se pehle replay aur live comparison pass karna hoga).

concepts.heading: Ek incident trace karna: koi agent country site ko touch nahi karta
concepts.body_md:
Incident run (`docs/capstone/example-runs/incident-lastn-ward-board/`) module 04 ke evidence pack se INC-2026-0922-01 replay karta hai. 08:00 UTC se, Clinic KE-C-017 ke 20 ward tablets har 30 s mein 100 subjects ke saath `lastn` call kar rahe the. `lastn` har subject par `frappe.get_doc` plus ek unbounded `frappe.get_all(fields=["*"])` chalata hai (`api/fhir.py:155-184`), aur CHG-5102 ne abhi-abhi har patient ko lagbhag 423 heart-rate readings di thi: har call par 200 statements aur lagbhag 42,300 rows, 9 sync gunicorn workers mein se ek 14 s se 120 s se zyada tak busy. Desk, login aur integrations ne 504 aur 502 return kiye; `default` par telephony reminder job har paanch minute mein time out hua.

System step by step kya karta hai:

- **01 brief (08:14)**: orchestrator on-call report mein named patient ko hata deta hai, 08:12 restart record karta hai, aur decide karta hai ki **security chalega**: ek naya integration client jo ek shared token par ward ke heart rates padhta hai "unexpected access" pattern hai, jo spec ki condition hai.
- **02 sre + 03 security parallel mein**: `build-timeline.mjs` exit 0 (125 events, time zones applied: Error Log rows +03:00 site time mein hain), `count-queries.mjs` `lastn` shape ko N+1 flag karta hai, paanch hypotheses ranked; M1 (tablets off), M2 (ward board ke liye nginx 429), M3 (telephony rollback, low confidence). Security: evidence mein koi PHI nahi, SEC-001 `get_all` User Permissions ignore karta hai, SEC-002 20 tablets ke liye ek token.
- **G-M round 1**: telephony team 08:20 par rollback karti hai. **04** verify karta hai: resolved nahi, bad deploy rejected.
- **G-M round 2** (spec jo aakhri allow karta hai): 08:31 par tablets off. **05**: 08:34 par recovered, queue 08:48 tak khud drain hui, `pg_stat_statements` 118,400 per-subject calls, har ek 423 rows; database aur OOM rejected.
- **06** fix ko `/bug-fix BUG-71` ko handover karta hai, ek alag run apne gates ke saath. **07** postmortem golden RCA se match karta hai aur `needs-human` rehta hai.

Retry `workflows/README.md` ka numbering rule dikhata hai: repeated step agla free number leta hai, isliye spec ke 05/06 ban gaye 06/07.

concepts.heading: Wiring verify karna: seams par checks, bench samet
Apne bench par le jaana: kya carry over hota hai aur kya nahi
concepts.body_md:
System ko course bench ke `spice_lite` se `spice_next_core`-style bench par le jaana zyadatar knowledge aur command swap hai, redesign nahi.

**Bina badle carry over hota hai**: saat roles aur unka separation of duties, handoff format aur `check-handoff.mjs`, orchestrator aur uske gate rules, `tool-guard.mjs` (sirf uske arguments badalte hain), governance Claude Code hooks, eval harness aur scoring, `verify-system.mjs` (yeh `--app-dir`, `--bench` aur `--site` leta hai).

**Badalna zaroori hai**, is order mein (`docs/capstone/personalize-checklist.md`):

1. `CLAUDE.md`: bench path, dev site, bench user, bench ki har app uske `required_apps` ke saath; personal paths `CLAUDE.local.md` mein.
2. Tumhare DocType, `patches.txt`, `hooks.py` aur country-app fixture paths ke liye `.claude/rules/*.md` `paths`.
3. Tumhare DocTypes se generated `context/**` (`doctype_summary.py` har DocType ke naming, indexes, Links aur DocPerm rows print karta hai), har patient-linked field ke liye PHI table ke saath.
4. Country apps aur integration apps: har ek `verify-system --app-dir` ki app rows pass kare; decide karo ki agents kaunsi edit kar sakte hain.
5. v15 par PostgreSQL 16: apne bench par D-2, D-6 aur D-10 re-check karo; eval traps ko apne Frappe source ki taraf point karo.
6. Agent guards aur settings: `test.localhost` ke bajaye tumhari dev site, `guard-bench.mjs` ke liye `SPICE_TEST_SITE` samet (settings `env` block; default `test.localhost`); har ask aur deny rakho.
7. Evals tumhare apne decisions, diffs aur incidents se re-seed; synthetic recordings delete.
8. `**/doctype/**`, `patches.txt`, `hooks.py`, fixtures aur har country app ke liye CODEOWNERS.

`scripts/capstone/stack-inventory.mjs` ise measurable banata hai: yeh app ke bahar ki har file list karta hai jo ab bhi `spice_lite`, course bench ya invented Kenya deployment mention karti hai, per component, aur `--max N` "kya hum done hain?" ko ek exit code mein badal deta hai.

11-verify-system.title: Prove karo ki poora system wired hai, bench samet, aur jo seam woh dhoondhta hai use explain karo
11-verify-system.objective: `scripts/capstone/verify-system.mjs` likho, ek zero-dependency Node script jo `AI-SDLC-frappe/` ka har cross-layer reference check kare (roster aur contracts, flat delegation, preloaded skills, Claude Code hook script paths aur events, Frappe permission floor, G1 gate settings, `.mcp.json`, workflow step tables, CLAUDE.md imports, har agent ke real Bash guard ke under skill scripts, `spice_lite` layout, `hooks.py` dotted paths, `modules.txt`, `patches.txt` modules, DocType folders, committed example runs, eval replay, module checkers) aur, `--bench` ke saath, bench khud (`apps/spice_lite`, `sites/apps.txt`, shared lock ke under `bench --site test.localhost list-apps`, bench ke Frappe source ke against eval traps). Ise broken fixtures aur ek fake bench ke against test karo, `--bench` ke saath aur bina chalao, aur prove karo ki jo ek WARN yeh report karta hai woh real hai. `AI-SDLC-frappe/README.md` aur `docs/capstone/README.md` likho taaki naya engineer ise dhoondh kar chala sake.

testCases.expected: Likhte waqt 24: 23 *.test.mjs files (--test ke saath chalne wale node:test suites) plus app ka `python3 -m unittest discover` (Ran 9 tests); koi FAIL rows nahi

testCases.name: README quickstart commands exist karte hain

evaluationCriteria: Har check real formats padhta hai (frontmatter `skills:` lists, settings `hooks` event map, `.mcp.json` `mcpServers`, `hooks.py`, `modules.txt`, `patches.txt` sections, DocType JSON), is repo ki file list hard-code nahi karta.
Guard reach usi `checkBash` se judge hota hai jo PreToolUse Claude Code hook chalata hai, `${CLAUDE_SKILL_DIR}` expand karke, kisi string comparison se nahi jo guard se disagree kar sake.
Bench optional hai: bina `--bench` ke Node ke bahar kuch spawn nahi hota; uske saath, bench call shared lock hold karti hai aur kabhi site badalne wala command nahi chalati.

Missing optional component (eval harness nahi, example runs nahi) SKIP hai; missing required component (roster agent, contract, gate settings, patch module) FAIL hai; design tension jo phir bhi kaam kare (skill aisa command pre-approve kare jise agent ka guard block karta hai) WARN hai.
Har FAIL row us file aur exact reference ka naam leti hai jo broken hai, taaki fix obvious ho.
README.md naye engineer ko bina course padhe bench build karne, verify, tests, evals aur gated workflow chalane deta hai.
improvements: `verify-system.mjs` ko `CI=1 bench --site test.localhost run-tests --app spice_lite` ke bagal mein required CI check ki tarah jodo (`docs/governance/` ka `ai-change-gate` workflow template hai).

`check-handoff.mjs` ko sikhao ki jo sre handoff aisa query count report kare jo usne measure nahi kiya, usme `## Test request (for the tester)` section require kare, taaki tester step skip na ho sake.
`--bench` ke saath, `spice-site` MCP server ke read-only API user se `patches.txt` ko site ke Patch Log se compare karo, taaki test site par kabhi na chali line country migrate se pehle dikh jaye.
Check karo ki har `agents/<name>/CONTRACT.md` un skills ka naam leta hai jo uski agent file preload karti hai.

11-feature-run.title: OBS-51 ko poore system se chalao aur har gate ka hisaab do
11-feature-run.objective: OBS-51 (Observation codes ke liye controlled vocabulary: naya DocType, `Data` se `Link`, fixture, patch) ke liye feature-delivery workflow ek fresh branch mein chalao, orchestrator ko main thread rakh kar, aur ek gate log banao: har step ke liye, kaunsa agent chala, kaunsa mechanism fire hua (Claude Code hook, permission prompt, migrate prompt, orchestrator stop, PR gate), aur kaunsa handoff aaya. Apne run folder ko `workflows/examples/feature-observation-code-vocabulary/` ke committed example se compare karo aur har difference explain karo. Dikhao ki evals (module 09) aur governance (module 10) kahan act hue, PR ko chahiye schema approval samet.

Committed example se har difference explain hai (alag finding ids, skipped step, reworks ki alag sankhya, test.localhost ke bajaye scratch site).
Log record karta hai ki kaunse evaluated agents (architect, reviewer) chale aur run se pehle kis replay result ne unhe clear kiya.
Learner ne G1 ka jawab 01 se 03 padhne ke baad diya, reflex se nahi (log plan ki ek detail quote karta hai, jaise patch section ya hooks.py mein fixture key).
G3 row CODEOWNERS paths aur approval gate ki schema category, dono ka naam leti hai.
improvements: Run se pehle aur baad `/usage` gate log mein save karo aur `docs/governance/model-and-cost-policy.md` ke run budget se compare karo.
Tester ne jo non-idempotent patch pakda (TST-1), uske liye `evaluations/datasets/reviewer-golden.json` mein ek golden task jodo, patch ko uska diff banakar.

Plain `claude --settings workflows/gates.settings.json` session mein `/feature` se rerun karo aur record karo ki handoff hook same tarah fire hua ya nahi (us mode mein sirf skill ka `hooks` registration active hai, aur `Agent(...)` allowlist enforce nahi hoti).

11-incident-run.title: Kenya site ke lastn ward-board incident ko system se guzaro
11-incident-run.objective: Production-rca evidence pack ke against INC-2026-0922-01 ke liye `/incident` chalao, dono mitigation gates par on-call engineer aur incident commander ka role nibhao, aur run folder banao: incident brief, parallel sre aur security triage, do verification steps, bug-fix handover, postmortem aur run report. Har handoff ko `check-handoff.mjs` pass karna hoga, sirf woh evidence cite karna hoga jo uske step ke waqt exist karta tha (Error Log ka +03:00 site time convert karke), PHI bahar rakhna hoga, aur site badalne wala har action insaan par chhodna hoga. Apne postmortem ko production-rca golden RCA se compare karo.

evaluationCriteria: Har step sirf woh evidence cite karta hai jiska timestamp uske chalne se pehle ka hai (08:17 par 02 ke paas na `pg_stat_statements` hai na kernel log; 05 ke paas dono hain), aur Error Log rows UTC par rakhi gayi hain, +03:00 site time par nahi.
Security run-or-skip decision spec condition aur evidence ke ek fact (ek shared token, har 30 s mein ward ke reads) se justified hai, guess se nahi.

Hypotheses evidence for aur against ke saath ranked hain; bad deploy, OOM, database aur Redis specific lines ke saath rejected hain (har SIGKILL se pehle `WORKER TIMEOUT`, bina asar ka rollback, Redis memory flat).
Mitigations insaan ke liye confidence levels ke saath options hain, kabhi agent ke liye gaye actions nahi; web restart aur gunicorn workers jodna explicitly fixes ki tarah recommend nahi kiye gaye.

`workflows/incident-response.md` ke queue-backlog incident type (`long` queue timeout se zyada chalne wala job) ke liye doosra evidence pack likho aur use same workflow se chalao.

11-move-to-your-bench.title: System ko ek measured checklist ke saath apne real spice_next_core-style bench par le jao
11-move-to-your-bench.objective: AI-SDLC system ko course bench ke `spice_lite` se apne bench par le jaane ka plan banao aur shuru karo (worked target: `required_apps` se declared country apps aur integration apps ke saath ek `spice_next_core` core app, PostgreSQL 16 par ek disposable dev site). `stack-inventory.mjs` se measure karo ki kaunsi files reference system encode karti hain, checklist order mein apply karo (CLAUDE.md bench aur site paths, tumhare DocType paths ke rules, tumhare DocTypes se generated context pack, country aur integration apps, Postgres 16 checks, guards aur settings, workflows aur MCP, tumhare apne incidents se re-seeded evals, CODEOWNERS), aur har step ko ek command se prove karo. Deliverable hai tumhari bhari hui checklist, ek terms file, pehle aur baad ke inventory numbers, aur tumhare bench ke against `verify-system` WIRED.

evaluationCriteria: Checklist aise ordered hai ki har step ka check pass ho sake: agents se pehle memory aur context, evals se pehle agents.
Har item ek named file ka concrete edit hai, use prove karne wale command ke saath; bench aur site paths CLAUDE.md mein, personal wale CLAUDE.local.md mein.
Context pack real DocType JSON (`doctype_summary.py`) se generated hai, aur PHI table har app ke har patient-linked field ko cover karti hai, search parameters samet.

Country apps aur integration apps apne `required_apps` ke saath listed hain, har ek app checks pass karti hai, aur developer ka write scope sirf un apps ka naam leta hai jin par owning teams ne haami bhari.
Site-secret aur bench deny rules move ke baad bhi bina badle rehte hain; sirf site names aur paths badalte hain.
Golden tasks team ke apne decisions, diffs aur incidents se re-seed hote hain, course wale translate nahi hote.
improvements: `stack-inventory.mjs` se ek checklist skeleton emit karwao (har matching file ke liye ek checkbox) taaki kuch miss na ho.

Bench-neutral parts (orchestrator, handoff hook, tool-guard, verify-system) ko `company-ai/` ke bagal mein doosre plugin ki tarah package karo, aur har project mein sirf bench aur app knowledge rakho.
Ek `verify-system` run mein kai apps ke liye `--app-dir` support jodo, taaki country deployment ka poora app set ek table mein check ho.

checklist: `node scripts/capstone/verify-system.mjs` aur `node scripts/capstone/verify-system.mjs --bench /home/user/frappe-bench` dono `-> WIRED` print karte hain aur exit 0 karte hain, aur pehla CI mein chalta hai.
`node scripts/capstone/verify-system.test.mjs` 34/34 pass karta hai aur `node scripts/capstone/stack-inventory.test.mjs` 9/9 pass karta hai.

Tum woh WARN explain kar sakte ho jo yeh check pehle report karta tha (sre ke guard ne woh `run-tests` command block kiya jo uski preloaded `performance-review` ne pre-approve kiya tha) aur kyon ab query count tester skill ki test request se measure karta hai.
Tum G1, G1b, G2, G-M aur G3 mein se har ek ke liye use enforce karne wale mechanism ka naam le sakte ho aur bata sakte ho ki kaunsa convention hai.
Har workflow run `default` permission mode mein `claude --agent orchestrator --settings workflows/gates.settings.json` se shuru hota hai.

Feature run ke saare handoffs `node .claude/hooks/check-handoff.mjs .ai-sdlc/runs/<run-id>` pass karte hain, aur DocType JSON, `patches.txt` ya `hooks.py` touch karne wala PR schema-owner approval ka intezaar karta hai.
Incident run mein kisi agent ne country site nahi badli; restart aur dono mitigations human actions ki tarah recorded hain.
Incident postmortem trigger, root cause, numbers aur PA-1..PA-8 par `skills/production-rca/tests/expected/INC-2026-0922-01-rca.md` se agree karta hai.
Run ke baad aane wale agent ya skill changes apne PR se pehle eval replay (aur live comparison) se guzarte hain, jo AI-config gate require karta hai.
`AI-SDLC-frappe/README.md` naye engineer ko bina course padhe `setup-bench.sh` se bench build karne, verify, tests, evals aur gated workflow chalane deta hai.
Tumhari move checklist mein ek baseline aur ek current `stack-inventory` number hai, aur `verify-system --app-dir ... --bench ...` tumhare apne bench ke against WIRED hai.
